title: shift+tab ring shows auto-edit for two different modes
observed: Ring manual→acceptEdits→plan→auto: acceptEdits and auto both render '● auto-edit' green; the user cannot tell which mode is active (status.go modeLabel maps both).
expected: Each ring stop has a distinct label; design MODES lists exactly three: ask before edits, auto-edit, plan only.

fix.note: auto now reads 'auto mode' (the name the permission prompts already use).
